content_fields.title: Manage and protect script processes (Bash/Shell)
content_fields.description: Supervise the process the script starts: serialize invocations, set a timeout and clean up on exit.
content_fields.finding: The teardown script starts a privileged process with no process isolation, locking or signal handling.
content_fields.required_fix:
#!/bin/bash
# stop_app.sh
set -euo pipefail

LOCK=/var/lock/restaurant-deploy.lock
exec 9>"$LOCK"
flock -n 9 || { echo "another deploy action is in progress" >&2; exit 1; }

trap 'rm -f "$LOCK"' EXIT

timeout 120 docker compose down
criteria: Concurrent invocations are prevented by a lock.
The privileged command runs under a timeout.
A trap cleans up on any exit path.
